command:
cat > /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.json && chmod 600 /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.json
/tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/sing-box check -c /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.json || exit
/tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/sing-box run -c /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.json >/tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.log 2>&1 & p=$!
sleep 2
if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo tun_process_running; ip link show tun-hwtest; kill "$p"; else wait "$p"; echo tun_exit=$?; fi
cat /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/tun.log
stdout:
tun_exit=1
[31mFATAL[0m[0000] start service: start inbound: start inbound/tun[tun-test]: configure tun interface: open tun: open /dev/net/tun: no such file or directory
